items.title: FII selling returns in first half of September  as financials, auto stocks face heavy outflows
items.description: In early September, foreign investors shifted to selling after a series of buying phases. Notably, financials, automotive, and oil and gas sectors experienced considerable sell-offs. Conversely, healthcare stocks attracted significant investments, reflecting a cautious market sentiment. Investors pulled back on auto and power stocks amidst rising global concerns, which collectively led to a subdued foreign portfolio investor presence.

items.title: Stocks in news: RVNL, Lenskart, Mazagon Dock, Maruti Suzuki India and Nestle India
items.description: Indian equities concluded Friday's session with marginal gains, supported by softer crude prices. Several companies like RVNL and Mazagon Dock are expected to be in focus on Monday. RVNL secured a significant order from East Coast Railway for railway line works. Mazagon Dock plans a substantial investment in a new shipyard project. Lenskart Solutions is anticipated to see a large block deal transaction.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: In the last few trading sessions, Indian markets have breathed a sigh of relief. The drop in Brent crude prices has mitigated worries about sustained supply chaos, positively impacting investor sentiment. Experts indicate a cautiously optimistic view now that the Federal Reserve's hikes are concluded. With falling Treasury yields and ample domestic liquidity supporting this movement, the Nifty could potentially climb higher if Brent crude stays below $96.

items.title: India Inc, individuals could soon get to settle fund diversion cases
items.description: India's Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is considering a novel approach to address fund siphoning cases. Offenders would return misappropriated funds along with interest, while also disclosing relevant details. This initiative aims to create a more realistic enforcement structure. The proposals, including a new mutual fund-specific category for portfolio management services, will be deliberated on September 24.

items.title: 'FCNR haul to power HSBC's India wealth, retail banking push'
items.description: HSBC forecasts that foreign currency deposits will significantly enhance its operations in India. By securing $14.5 billion through a special RBI swap facility, the bank aims to expand lending and wealth management services. The attractive leverage option of up to nineteen times has drawn in depositors. HSBC's strategy is to deploy these funds cautiously toward corporate lending and mortgage offerings.

items.title: NMDC shares rally 2% after company sets target to achieve net-zero operational emissions by 2047
items.description: NMDC shares rallied up to 2% on Monday to Rs 80.85 after setting a target to achieve net-zero operational emissions by 2047. Covering Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions, the roadmap spans three phases focusing on renewable energy, fleet electrification, energy efficiency, and low-carbon logistics to reduce operational emissions by 90%.

items.title: HAL shares rise 2% as firm hands over 3 aerospace platforms to IAF. What is Goldman Sachs saying?
items.description: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) shares rose on Monday after the company handed over three indigenously developed platforms to the IAF and Pawan Hans. The deliveries included the Dhruv-NG helicopter, LCA Tejas Trainer jets and HTT-40 basic trainer aircraft.

items.title: Ather Energy among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of September 18, five stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 5% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This can reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of existing positions.

items.title: OFSS shares tumble 7%; Wipro, Coforge, Infosys shares down up to 2%. Why are IT stocks under pressure today?
items.description: Shares of OFSS fell over 7% while top IT stocks including Infosys, Wipro, and Coforge dropped up to 2% on Monday. The drag comes following reports of Oracle's $18 billion data centre debt pressure and US President Donald Trump extending the $100,000 H-1B visa fee by another year.

items.description: Are cement companies able to raise prices as the monsoon ends? Do those increases hold the way they have in recent years? The answers to these questions will tell you whether there is strong enough demand to help the sector handle cost pressures. items.title: Pine Labs shares can rally 30%, says Motilal Oswal after initiating coverage with Buy. Here’s why
items.description: Pine Labs shares gained after Motilal Oswal initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a Rs 250 target, implying 30% upside. The brokerage sees the merchant commerce platform benefiting from multiple monetisation avenues, with affordability, digital payments and issuing businesses driving growth. DITP is expected to remain its largest revenue contributor.

items.title: HEG shares rally 5% after receiving Rs 217.56 crore order from Indus Towers for lithium-ion battery banks
items.description: HEG shares rose sharply on Monday after subsidiary Replus Engitech received a Rs 217.56 crore order from Indus Towers for lithium-ion battery banks. The order is to be executed by March 31, 2027. The development comes as HEG progresses with its demerger into separate graphite electrodes and advanced materials businesses.

items.title: RIL selloff wipes off Rs 4 lakh crore from market value as shares drop 21% in 2026 so far. Should you buy now?
items.description: In 2026, Reliance Industries has seen a sharp decline of twenty-one percent in its share prices, wiping out an impressive four lakh crore rupees from its market worth. Analysts recommend that investors should be wary and avoid the temptation to buy during this dip, as the company is currently grappling with windfall tax implications and rising concerns regarding a Jio listing.

items.title: Sensex jumps 550 points, Nifty nears 23,400 as oil prices cool down despite Middle East tensions. What lies ahead?
items.description: Indian equities gained in early trade as lower crude prices lifted sentiment, with Sensex rising 0.6% and Nifty 0.2%. Analysts expect volatility to persist amid geopolitical risks, elevated yields and sectoral rotation.

items.title: JSW Cement shares gain 2% after Motilal Oswal upgrades stock to Buy. Check target price
items.description: JSW Cement shares gained nearly 2% after Motilal Oswal upgraded the stock to Buy from Neutral, citing strong volume growth, North India expansion, cost efficiencies and an improving medium-term growth outlook.

items.title: Lenskart shares drop 3% after 3 crore shares change hands in block deal; Platinum Jasmine likely seller
items.description: Lenskart Solutions shares fell over 3% to Rs 683 after a massive block deal worth Rs 2,047 crore saw 3.53 crore shares change hands. Platinum Jasmine is likely the seller offloading a 1.7% stake. Despite today's drop, the stock remains up over 58% in 2026.

items.title: Goldman Sachs names 5 power generation stocks that are AI enablers amid soaring demand
items.description: India’s stock market may be masking a powerful AI opportunity. While the Nifty has declined 12% in 2026, AI-linked companies have surged as demand rises for the power, data centres and semiconductor infrastructure needed to support the global AI build-out. Here are five power-generation stocks that Goldman Sachs says are AI-enablers.

items.title: One97 Communications among 4 stocks closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On September 18, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty 200 pack were more than 2% above their respective VWAPs (Volume-Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge's technical scan data.When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Tata Chemicals, Tata Investment Corp shares fall up to 3% as boardroom battle likely to reach court
items.description: The dispute between Tata Trusts and Tata Sons over N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment escalated, with the matter potentially heading to court. Tata Sons recently approved a fresh five-year extension for Chandrasekaran and began preparations for its IPO, triggering sharp moves in group stocks. However, shares fell on Friday after Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata challenged the validity of the appointment, objecting to the manner in which the decision was taken.

items.title: Welspun Corp shares rally 5% as firm bags Rs 2,000 crore order from Saudi Aramco; stock up over 230% YTD
items.description: Welspun Corp shares are in focus after its associate company EPIC secured a Rs 2,000 crore Saudi Aramco order for steel pipes. The stock has surged 232% in 2026, leading the Nifty 500 this year. Earlier this month, Welspun Corp also signed an MoU with Perma-Pipe International Holdings Inc.

items.title: FIIs pull out ₹6,200 crore from financials but CIOs say banks could be India’s next big largecap trade
items.description: Recent trends show foreign investors exiting financial services, leading to notable outflows. In contrast, mutual fund chief investment officers highlight banking as a promising large-cap opportunity, citing appealing valuations and robust fundamentals. Although foreign selling is widespread, sectors like healthcare and construction are attracting investments. Experts confidently assert that the current undervaluation of banking creates a strong case for investment.
